message.content:
Below is a concise, ready‑to‑use list of the **federal public holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., Family Day in Ontario, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.—just let me know and I can add those too.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|---------------|-------|
| **Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | ✅ | Observed Monday because Jan 1 fell on a Sunday |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | ✅ | Friday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | ✅ | Monday – 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | ✅ | Observed Monday because Jul 1 was a Saturday |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | ✅ | Monday – 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | ✅ | Monday – 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Nov 10** | Remembrance Day | ✅ | Friday – 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | ✅ | Monday – 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |

> **Quick JSON snippet** (perfect for importing into your holiday‑planning app)

```json
[
  {"date":"2023-01-02","holiday":"New Year's Day (observed)","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-04-07","holiday":"Good Friday","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-05-22","holiday":"Victoria Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-07-03","holiday":"Canada Day (observed)","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-09-04","holiday":"Labour Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-10-09","holiday":"Thanksgiving","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-11-10","holiday":"Remembrance Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-12-25","holiday":"Christmas Day","longWeekend":true}
]
```

### How to fetch this data programmatically

If you prefer an API, the free **Nager.Date** service provides public holiday data for Canada:

```
GET https://date.nager.at/api/v2/publicholidays/2023/CA
```

The response includes all federal holidays (and some provincial ones) with dates, local names, and whether they’re observed on a different day. You can filter for `longWeekend`‑type holidays by checking if the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday.

---

Let me know if you’d like province‑specific long weekends or any other customization!
